message.reasoning_content: Harrison-only lead: The Honeymoon Song? Yes, Harrison sings it solo (BBC). "Lonesome Tears in My Eyes" also Harrison solo lead? BBC song sung by George. Hmm. Both. "Chains" also George. All You Need Is Love is John. Harrison lead: Chains, Lonesome Tears, Honeymoon — all solo George actually. Which is known Beatles release? Chains on Please Please Me — George only lead. The Honeymoon Song is BBC only. "Lonesome Tears" BBC, George lead too. Pick Chains? Honeymoon Song also George only. Choose Chains—well Live at the BBC both exist. Probability moderate.
